company.shortDescription: Avey is a healthcare technology that specializes in deep science AI.
company.description:
Avey  is a cutting-edge healthcare technology company dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through advanced AI-driven solutions. Founded with the mission to empower health, Avey leverages its proprietary and novel AI models to offer innovative, comprehensive tools that enhance clinical efficiency, improve patient outcomes, and optimize financial operations for healthcare providers.

Avey’s suite of products, namely Avey Collaborator, Avey Cowriter, and Avey Coder, create a seamless ecosystem that transforms the entire healthcare delivery process. From automating documentation and generating real-time diagnostic insights to streamlining medical coding and claim processing, Avey’s solutions address critical pain points in the healthcare industry
